paite: Huai ni chiang in khelhna leh nitna siangsak ding in, David inkote leh Jerusalem a tengte a ding in tuikhuk kihong ahong om ding hi.
heading: Jerusalem Hihsianthouna

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, gam a kipan in milimte minte ka satkhe ding a, theihgige in a-omta kei ding uh; huan zawlneite leh kha nin gam a kipan in ka paikhesak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, zawlnei kuapeuh ahong kilat laileh amah suangtu anu leh apa'n akiang ah, "Na hing kei ding; TOUPA min in zuau na gen a," achi ding ua; amah suangtu anu leh apa'n thu agenkholh ziak in amah asun pailet ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, zawlneite thu agenkholhna uah, amengmuh uah azahlak chiat ding ua; khem ding in samul phan puanak leng asilh sam kei ding uhi.
"Zawlnei ka hi kei, leiletmi ka hi; ka tuailai a kipan a sikha a bawl ka hih khit tak ziak in,” achi zaw ding uhi.
Mi'n akiang ah, na bante kikal a liamnate bang ahia? achi ding ua, huchi in ama'n, "Huaite ka lawmte insung a ka liamnate ahi uh," chi in adawng ding uhi.
"Aw namsau, ka belamchingmi dou ding leh mi ka lawm dou ding in halh in, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Belamchingmi khen in, huan belamte adalh ding uh; huchi in aneute tung ah ka khut ka lik ding hi.
heading: Belamchingtu Khetna

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, gam tengteng ah, huai a seh nih satkhiak in a-om dia asi ding uhi; himahleh huai a athumna nutsiat in a-om ding, TOUPA'N achi.

Huan aseh thumna mei a paisuak in ka hon tawi dia, dangka hihsiangthou bang in ka hihsiangthou ding a, dangka ettel bang in ka entel ding hi; ka min alou ding ua, amau ka dawng ding; ka mite ahi, ka chi dia, amau, TOUPA ka Pathian ahi," hon chi ding uhi.
